scope: Software-only uploader fixture, no port opening or physical upload. Mutates compiled binary or a header after the real fixture SDK scan and before upload can begin.

before.result: Unsafe baseline reached the fixture uploader instead of rejecting the changed artifact.

after.result: Both artifact and source mutations reject before any uploader call.

change: The full SDK integrity scan now precedes the final bounded artifact and source checks; no second manifest read or duplicate binary pass added.
limits: Does not eliminate every interprocess TOCTOU race, prove hardware behavior or provide an OS sandbox.
